title: Offset edges
tagline: Offset one chain by amounts that vary along its length -- regions with ramps and dwells, blended; in-plane or out-of-plane; sharp corners handled.

slides.title: What it does
slides.problem: Native Offset curve is constant and in a sketch plane. Ski edges need offsets that change along the length -- a bevel that grows toward the tip, a step between two zones -- following a 3D chain.
useWhen: Offsets that vary along a sidecut or edge line
slides.caption: OE6 regions + blend, OE10 pins, OE24 corner.

points.head: Per region
points.body: Extent (distances from the reference or two points), start / end offset, Linear / Quadratic / Smooth, dwells.

points.head: Blends
points.body: Neighbouring regions blended over a distance into each, matched to G0 / G1 / G2.

points.head: Or pins
points.body: Single region: offsets at chosen points, flat beyond the first and last.

points.head: 'Normal offset'
points.body: Moves OUT of the chain's plane (a line in XY offsets along Z).

points.head: 'Binormal offset'
points.body: Moves WITHIN the plane, toward / away from the centre of curvature.

points.head: Names
points.body: The reverse of Frenet naming: describe results physically.

slides.title: The dialog
params: One chain (G1, or with sharp corners).
Reverse the distance direction (+ Show direction indicator).
Reverse the out-of-plane direction (Flip binormal likewise).
Convert to splines / Keep as arcs (concentric or arc pairs).
Type, name, extent, offset type, start / end offsets, dwells.
Per neighbouring pair: blend, continuities, distances.
Degree 3, tolerance 0.01 mm, max control points 100.
Show frames / regions / blends; print data.

keys: One wire, split at source-edge boundaries and region / blend joints.
messages: Keep as arcs with varying offsets.
no regions / overlapping regions / clamped dwell or blend / region consumed by blends

items.head: Keep as arcs
items.body: Constant offsets of arcs stay exact arcs (report a radius).

items.head: Gaps
items.body: Gaps between regions are gaps in the output; blending off gives a step.

items.head: Slivers
items.body: A region boundary within ~1 mm of an edge boundary can leave a sliver edge.
